commit.subject: LU-19743 tests: Allow multiple FID formats on debugfs tests
commit.message:
LU-19743 tests: Allow multiple FID formats on debugfs tests

Since new debugfs FID output will not output brace in the future,
related tests must support both DFID and DFID_NOBRACE format FIDs
for test interop compatibility.

Make the b2_15 check_seq_oid() identical to master for simplicity.
